'''R5-A2''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid]]<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-au/product/sandcrawler-75220|text=Sandcrawler 75220}}</ref> with [[Color|orange]] and white paneling and black [[sensor]]s.<ref name="ANH" /> It stood ninety-seven [[centimeter]]s tall and, like all [[R-series]] units, was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events that take place on [[Tatooine]] in {{Film|IV}} to [[1 BBY]].</ref> it was present in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], where it rolled across<ref name="ANH" /> the intersection of [[Corporations Road]] and [[Dune Street]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> in front of a [[Foot Patrol 7|group]] of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s questioning the [[Jedi Master|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] while the pair sat in a [[X-34 landspeeder]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-A2 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The droid's scene was shot between [[April 2]] and [[April 4]], [[1976]] on location in [[Wikipedia:Djerba|Djerba]], [[Wikipedia:Tunisia|Tunisia]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the [[droid]] was first identified in the online description for the [[2018]] [[LEGO]] set "[[W:c:lego:75220 Sandcrawler|Sandcrawler 75220]]." The set depicted R5-A2 as being on board the [[Jawa]] [[sandcrawler]] in ''A New Hope'',<ref name="LEGO" /> something not depicted in the film,<ref name="ANH" /> with a non-canon character entry on LEGO's website explaining that the droid was captured by Jawas after roaming the streets of Mos Eisley and was brought to the sandcrawler to be sold for scrap.<ref name="LEGOKids">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-gb/kids/characters/star-wars/r5-a2-fdc5929515a045f88e6da8e8d8606bdf|text=R5-A2™|nolive=1}}</ref> R5-A2 was one of the characters featured in the [[2021]] non-canon browser game [[LEGO Kids Memory Game|''LEGO Star Wars: Find the pairs'']] released on LEGO.com.<ref name="LEGOPAIRS">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/kids/star-wars/find-the-pairs|text=Find the pairs|nolive=1}}</ref>

The droid's name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1996]] ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion released for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=R5-A2}}</ref> In the multiplayer mode of the [[2017]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'', multiple astromechs identical to R5-A2 can be encountered on the Mos Eisley map.<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>
